<xf:macro name="hide" arg-tag="!" arg-options="!"> <xf:if is="in_array($options.hideMappedTo, ['hidereact', 'hidereplyreact', 'hidereplyorreact'])"> <xf:macro name="react" arg-tag="{$tag}" arg-options="{$options}" /> <xf:elseif is="!in_array($options.hideMappedTo, ['hidereply', 'hidethanks', 'hidereplythanks', 'hideguest'])" /> <xf:macro name="{$options.hideMappedTo}" arg-tag="{$tag}" arg-options="{$options}" /> </xf:if>
<xf:hiddenval name="hide_mapped_to" class="js-hideMappedTo">{$options.hideMappedTo}</xf:hiddenval> </xf:macro>
<xf:macro name="react" arg-tag="!" arg-options="!"> <xf:checkboxrow listclass="listColumns"> <xf:foreach loop="$options.reactions" key="$reactionId" value="$reaction"> <xf:set var="{$title}"><xf:reaction id="{$reactionId}" showtitle="true" class="reaction--inline" /></xf:set> <xf:option value="{$reactionId}" id="editor_input_{$tag}_val" selected="{{ $reactionId === 1 ? true : false }}"> {$title} </xf:option> </xf:foreach> </xf:checkboxrow> </xf:macro>
<xf:macro name="hideusergroups" arg-tag="!" arg-options="!"> <xf:checkboxrow listclass="listColumns"> <xf:foreach loop="$options.usergroups" key="$userGroupId" value="$userGroup">
<xf:set var="{$title}">{$userGroup}</xf:set>
<xf:option value="{$userGroupId}" id="editor_input_{$tag}_val"> {$title}
</xf:option> </xf:foreach> </xf:checkboxrow> </xf:macro>
<xf:macro name="hideshowtogroups" arg-tag="!" arg-options="!"> <xf:checkboxrow listclass="listColumns"> <xf:foreach loop="$options.usergroups" key="$userGroupId" value="$userGroup">
<xf:set var="{$title}">{$userGroup}</xf:set>
<xf:option value="{$userGroupId}" id="editor_input_{$tag}_val"> {$title}
</xf:option> </xf:foreach> </xf:checkboxrow> </xf:macro>
<xf:macro name="hideuser" arg-tag="!"> <xf:tokeninputrow name="editor_hide" href="{{ link('members/find') }}" inputclass="js-editor_input_{$tag}_val" rowtype="fullWidth" label="{{ phrase('xc_hide_bbcode_users') }}" explain="{{ phrase('separate_names_with_comma') }}" /> </xf:macro>
<xf:macro name="hideposts" arg-tag="!"> <xf:numberboxrow id="editor_input_{$tag}_val" label="{{ phrase('xc_hide_bbcode_post_count') }}" explain="{{ phrase('xc_hide_bbcode_post_count_explain') }}" min="0" step="1" max="1000" /> </xf:macro>
<xf:macro name="hideage" arg-tag="!"> <xf:numberboxrow id="editor_input_{$tag}_val" label="{{ phrase('xc_hide_bbcode_age_required') }}" explain="{{ phrase('xc_hide_bbcode_age_required_explain') }}" min="0" step="1" max="100" /> </xf:macro>
<xf:macro name="hidetrophy" arg-tag="!"> <xf:numberboxrow id="editor_input_{$tag}_val" label="{{ phrase('xc_hide_bbcode_trophy_points') }}" explain="{{ phrase('xc_hide_bbcode_trophy_points_explain') }}" min="1" step="1" max="1000" /> </xf:macro>
<xf:macro name="hidereactscore" arg-tag="!"> <xf:numberboxrow id="editor_input_{$tag}_val" label="{{ phrase('xc_hide_reaction_score') }}" explain="{{ phrase('xc_hide_reaction_score_explain') }}" min="1" step="1" max="1000" /> </xf:macro>
